name: Lorard Hask
role: Lord-Marshal of the Ash Companies; commands all arms under the regency
appearance: Broad, grey at the temples, a soldier's limp from a Shaar spear; plain field plate with no crest.
voice: Short, clipped sentences; counts things out loud; calls people by trade or rank; cracks his knuckles one at a time before something hard.
backstory: Born in the Ash Company's camp in 1450 and acknowledged at seven as the king's firstborn, Lorard spent twenty years half-exiled on the South March for opposing the Sky Gallows. He hanged one man in ten at Thornwater in 1484 to save the rest. After the king died he gave Kharun ten days; the gates opened on day 9, and three hundred of his men marched in. At the forge he stripped his own quartermaster for staging a riot, and at the noon council he voted for the regency.
wants: The throne without sacking his own capital; under that, a father's approval he never got.
fears: Becoming his father: a man who could order a hundred deaths in that soft voice and then sleep.
secrets: He is not Ivoard's son: his father was Pellot Rook. He learned it from his dying mother's letter and keeps the letter in a locked dispatch case.
He had the last witness, the old company surgeon, pushed from a wall at Fort Vell.
dm_only: Chadickith, Marda Ironside and Hesard Rook also know his parentage; Halda learns on day 14 unless Chadickith intervenes.
He truly did not know about Unara's scheme.
